name: OpenMind Telemetry
whatItDoes: Telemetry and monitoring module for robotics fleets. Exposes health metrics, logs, and ROS topics with insights into system performance and operational status. Integrates with monitoring dashboards and observability platforms.
whyItSavesTime: Ready-to-deploy monitoring eliminates weeks of custom telemetry development. Built-in integration with StreamDeploy dashboards and external observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana.
